test_title: PYST 26 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: 5 friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). H is sitting to the immediate right of C. B is sitting third to the left of H. P is not an immediate neighbour of C. Who is to the immediate left of C?
solution:
**Given:** 5 friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1. B is sitting third to the left of H.

2. H is sitting to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7a8475a48621425a4b487057121b6d6ddee76629b418514cc3d3596773219c3.png] 

3. P is not an immediate neighbour of C.

So, P sits between H and B.
